# TracedOptions interface

Options for the [traced()](/api/dd-trace/latest/dd-trace.traced/) method decorator. Every field is optional at the call site — `traced()` takes a `Partial` of this and fills the rest in.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface TracedOptions 
```
